behavior: ResolveRoles is a pure sorted join over personas loaded via harness.LoadPersona, with no I/O and no second parse of AGENT.md

Ambiguity is returned in full and never ranked: code-complexity-and-refactor resolves to [builder reviewer] and spec-driven-development to [planner reviewer]; a rule with no skills returns empty without error
A Go drift guard spans triggers.json and the persona roster: red when the resolving-rule count drops below 16, and red when any persona contributes zero skills
The UserPromptSubmit hook is emitted from harness/manifest.json so a deploy propagates it, rather than being hand-written into settings.json
The hook reads its payload from stdin; no --prompt argument exists or is accepted, because a shell-quoted user prompt is an injection surface
Every plausible prompt-field spelling is accepted and the one that arrived is recorded; an unrecognised payload records that fact instead of guessing
The hook exits 0 under every failure mode - malformed payload, empty payload, unreadable persona record, unparseable triggers.json - because exit 2 on UserPromptSubmit erases the user's prompt
The full match and join completes within the stated 20ms budget, asserted by test so a latency regression on the every-prompt path is visible
